answer_1.quote: we develop PErceive and Generate Stickers (PEGS), an advanced multimodal empathetic dialogue framework.
answer_1.outputs: Multimodal empathetic responses including text and stickers

answer_2.quote: we utilize an array of broadly recognized text metrics, comprising BLEU , Distinct-n (Dist-n)  , ROUGE-L (ROU_L) , METEOR (MET) , CIDEr , BERTScore (BERTS) .

answer_3.quote: We introduce three LLM-based metrics: (1) Empathy: We assess empathy in model responses... (2) Consistency: Based on the context, we assign consistency scores... (3) Rank: We compare responses of different models to the same context.

answer_4.quote: The evaluation panel consists of five members who score models anonymously... Metrics are scored on a 1 to 5 scale, with higher scores denoting better performance.
answer_4.guideline: Seven detailed manual evaluation metrics: Sticker Generation Quality (StiGQ), Empathy Sticker (Es), Empathy Text (Et), Consistency (Con), Fluency (Flu), Informativity (Inf), Sticker Diversity (StiD).
